from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document as found in the text, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    case_category: Literal['行政行为 - 行政复议', '危害公共安全罪', '行政行为 - 行政撤销', '渎职罪', '行政行为 - 行政征收', '行政行为 - 行政许可', '与公司，证券，保险，票据等有关的民事纠纷', '人格权纠纷'] = Field(description="The specific cause of action category from the task list that this document belongs to")
    evidence_quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all findings for the current document being parsed."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
